note: The Dallas County page for the May 8, 2010 joint election links only a redirect page (to results.enr.clarityelections.com, Dallas 16612) and an Access database, and the results could not be read. The City of Irving website returned HTTP 403 to every request, so the city election list could not be opened. Whether a mayoral race occurred in 2010 is not confirmed.

The Dallas County Elections Department final results show a May 14, 2011 first round with no majority winner (Van Duyne 4,377; Gears 3,986). The June 18, 2011 runoff decided the office. Details are in irving_results.json.

The Dallas County results document linked here lists Irving council or school contests but no Irving mayoral contest in the joint election it covers. No official city source (charter, city clerk list of mayors or elections) that states the mayoral term length or the election years could be opened: the City of Irving website returned HTTP 403 to every request, and the Dallas County city notice CoI-Notice-of-Election-050226.pdf downloaded as an empty file. Mayoral races were found in 2011, 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2026 in county results, but a cycle inferred from those rows is not an official cycle source, and absence from one results document does not exclude a mayoral election at another date that year. The year is left unresolved after the checker review.
